name: China
note: Inventions with a recorded country of origin in Wikidata, topped up from the English Wikipedia's per-country invention list articles (CC BY-SA). Every entry passed a Wikidata class check (device, technology, process, product, software, medication ...); diseases, species, discoveries, theorems and food are excluded by ruling. Dates are recorded or parsed from prose and are often approximate.

inventions.name: xiao
inventions.description: The xiao is a Chinese vertical end-blown flute.

inventions.name: Bellows
inventions.description: Bellows are a device constructed to expel a controlled blast of air.

inventions.name: Cannon
inventions.description: A cannon is a large-caliber gun classified as a type of artillery, which usually launches a projectile using explosive chemical propellant.

inventions.name: Chain drive
inventions.description: A chain drive is a way of transmitting mechanical power from one place to another.

inventions.name: Amalgam (dentistry)
inventions.description: In dentistry, amalgam is an alloy of mercury used to fill teeth cavities.

inventions.name: Loom
inventions.description: A loom is a device used to weave cloth and tapestry.

inventions.name: Firecracker
inventions.description: A firecracker is a small explosive device primarily designed to produce a large amount of noise, especially in the form of a loud bang, usually for celebration or entertainment; any visual effect is incidental to this…

inventions.name: Flamethrower
inventions.description: A flamethrower is a ranged incendiary device designed to project a controllable jet of fire.

inventions.name: Hand cannon
inventions.description: The hand cannon, also known as the gonne or handgonne, is the first true firearm and the successor of the fire lance.

inventions.name: Horse collar
inventions.description: A horse collar is a component of horse harness designed to distribute the force of a load evenly across a horse's shoulders and chest, enabling efficient pulling of a load while not interfering with a horse's windpipe.

inventions.name: India ink
inventions.description: India ink or China ink is a simple black or coloured ink once widely used for writing and printing and now more commonly used for drawing and outlining, especially when inking comic books and comic strips.

inventions.name: Kite
inventions.description: A kite is a tethered heavier-than-air craft with wing surfaces that react against the air to create lift and drag forces.
